snippet.title: IShowSpeed Celebrated Messi's Miss... Then He Started Crying
snippet.description:
IShowSpeed has always been a huge Cristiano Ronaldo fan and didn't want Lionel Messi to score.

So when Messi missed the goal, Speed immediately celebrated and started making his famous reactions.

But a few weeks later, Speed went to watch the World Cup final and supported Spain.

He was happy when Messi and his team lost the match.

Then everything changed.

Speed saw Messi crying on the field and suddenly couldn't control his own emotions.

He started crying too.

Because in that moment, Speed realized this might be the last time he ever watched Messi play.

What started with Speed celebrating Messi's missed goal ended with him becoming emotional after seeing one of football's greatest players in tears.
